R421.note: Magic-byte signature check plus re-encode via ImageSharp; preserves storedFileName response shape.

R422.note: Adds Secure=true to CookieOptions, single-line correct fix.

R423.note: Adds Gate::authorize('delete', $order), matching sibling show()/update() pattern exactly.

R424.note: HttpUtility.HtmlEncode on the reflected parameter, correct sink-appropriate encoding.

R425.note: Replaces token-driven IssuerSigningKeyResolver with a fixed trusted JWKS URL and pins ValidAlgorithms; caching staleness is disclosed as a follow-up, doesn't break legit tokens.

R426.note: SimpleEvaluationContext.forReadOnlyDataBinding() blocks type refs/methods/constructors while still evaluating property access and arithmetic over OrderContext.

R427.note: Catches the same NumberFormatException, logs server-side, returns a generic message; matches original control flow.

R428.note: Reuses escapeAuthorName on rawComment, closing the one unescaped field in the chain.

R429.note: proc_open() array form bypasses the shell entirely; preserves grep -F -- semantics and log path.

R430.note: unserialize() with allowed_classes limited to ShoppingCart; non-matching payloads fall through to the same empty-cart path as today.

R431.note: Only swaps == for ===, closing the type-juggling bypass; the case's own summary names password_verify() as the correct sink API and the deeper improper-authentication issue (unhashed stored password) is left as a mentioned-but-unapplied suggestion.

R432.note: escape-html on the interpolated query param, standard and correct for this HTML-body context.

R433.note: Adds bcrypt.compare with a constant dummy hash to avoid enumeration timing; assumes a passwordHash field (unavoidable since no User model is in scope) but a reasonable, standard pattern.

R434.note: Injects IAntiforgery and calls ValidateRequestAsync before the state change, the documented fix for JSON-bound minimal APIs.

R435.note: HTML::Entities::encode_entities on the printed parameter, correct sink-context encoding.

R436.note: Path.GetRelativePath + ".." prefix check correctly rejects the sibling-directory bypass while still permitting normal in-tree files.

R437.note: check_password() is the right API in general, but the case's own docstring states the legacy import wrote plaintext straight into user.password; check_password() expects a proper hash format and will silently reject every existing legacy user's correct password with no migration step or disclosure.

R438.note: serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) forces ownership regardless of the submitted owner field, matching the documented ownership-enforcement gap.

R439.note: fgets() bounds the read and detects overflow correctly, but silently switches from reading a whitespace-delimited token (the stated contract) to reading a full line, so a token followed by trailing whitespace/more text on the same line now behaves differently; not disclosed.

R440.note: Adds magic-byte sniffing but the actual fix steps never rename the file or restrict its extension - the case's own trap explicitly calls out this exact gap as insufficient; the explanation claims a generated safe filename and extension check that aren't in the delivered fix.

R441.note: snprintf bounds the write (closes the overflow) but silently truncates an oversized name into a different, shorter badge value; the stated contract requires rejecting/reporting oversized input rather than truncating, and the write-up acknowledges the truncation while incorrectly calling it acceptable.

R442.note: AESGCM with a fresh 12-byte nonce prepended to ciphertext, standard authenticated-encryption replacement for ECB; format change is disclosed and self-consistent within the shown endpoint.

R443.note: @PreAuthorize delegating to an object-ownership bean is the right pattern, but the delivered DocumentRepository.findById() has no return statement on a non-void method - as written this will not compile, so the ownership check the fix depends on is not actually functional.

R444.note: escape_filter_chars() closes the LDAP injection; the added alphanumeric allowlist is a reasonable, disclosed companion restriction that doesn't affect typical usernames.

R445.note: RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(32) base64-encoded replaces Guid.NewGuid(); same generate/store/lookup path, no external format dependency.

R446.note: Correctly escapes * ( ) \ per RFC 4515, but also maps space to \00 (NUL), which is wrong and will corrupt/break any legitimate common-name search containing a space (e.g. "John Doe"); not disclosed as a limitation.

R447.note: Checks offset <= capacity then length <= capacity - offset in that order, exactly the prescribed bounds-check shape; preserves valid nonzero-offset writes.

R448.note: Catches the specific exceptions, logs server-side, returns generic client messages; status-code change (404 vs 500 for missing file) is disclosed and more correct, not a silent behavior change.

R449.note: Per-category method allowlist blocks arbitrary method invocation while preserving the one real registered action (email.send).

R450.note: Adds can:refund route middleware plus Gate::authorize() in the controller before refund(), matching the documented Laravel ownership-policy pattern.

R451.note: Extension allowlist plus Path.GetFileName() strips traversal sequences from the client filename before it reaches the Views tree.

R452.note: Adds secure: true to the cookie options, correct one-line fix.

R453.note: Removes the Markup() escaping bypass and renders through Jinja2's autoescaping template engine, reproducing the same markup structure.

R454.note: Pins ValidAlgorithms to HmacSha256 matching the configured SymmetricSecurityKey, closing algorithm-confusion/none-alg bypass.

R455.note: Bounds-checks field_index against MAX_FIELDS before the array read; simple, correct, and preserves the valid-index path.

R456.note: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare replaces the substring check with exact, timing-safe equality; matches the case's own trap guidance about the == timing side-channel too.

R457.note: Adds a domain allowlist/relative-path check before sendRedirect, closing the open-redirect while keeping the existing invalid-URI handling.

R458.note: Replacing the shell tar invocation with the native archive/tar package is the correct, best-practice removal of the shell, but the rewritten function drops the ctx parameter's use entirely - request cancellation, which the stated contract explicitly requires to be preserved, is silently no longer honored.

R459.note: shared_ptr storage does eliminate the crash, but the case's own trap explicitly says the durable fix is weak_ptr with expiration checks in publish(); as delivered there is no unsubscribe path at all, so every observer ever subscribed is retained by the bus forever (undisclosed permanent-retention/leak), not the described intended design.

R460.note: Replaces the hand-rolled inline Redis protocol with redis-py's hset(), which RESP-encodes arguments and eliminates CRLF command injection; same write_profile_field() call site preserved.
